description: A dedicated Education Counsellor based in Pune with two years of comprehensive experience, specializing in guiding students through end-to-end admission processes for Engineering, MBA, and Law programs across India. Recognized for expert knowledge of college selection, application procedures, and seat allocation strategies, this counselor has successfully helped numerous students secure admissions nationwide. With a strong understanding of educational trends and a personalized counseling approach, they provide clear support for aspirants to navigate competitive entry requirements and make informed decisions for their academic futures.
